summary: The ConfirmedEditAll file is a component of the HSPnet system used for managing enrollment data. It defines user controls and workflows for editing enrollment records, handling user input and session parameters, screen access validation, and redirects based on user commands.
purpose: To enable batch editing of enrollment records in the HSPnet system, providing a user interface for filtering, sorting, updating, and saving enrollment data.

workflows.name: Edit Enrollment Data
steps: Set input parameters based on session and filters

business_rules: Screen is editable if the enrollment is not waived, graduated, or inactive
If ReadOnly flag is true, disable editing
validations: Ensure UserSession is valid before processing
Limit text input in txtNotes to 200 characters
calculations: Calculate shifts based on actual hours and shift length
Determine txtDurationShifts value based on shift calculations
conditions: If EnrollmentID is set, alter grid visibility based on row types
system_behavior: Disable edit fields if ReadOnly flag is true
Hide buttons conditionally based on access settings and data state
Register JavaScript variables for client-side operations
exceptions: Cancel data selection if UserSession is null
Break workflow if warning messages are detected
